description: New General ACCDB. X(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(20), N Long) and X2(K, N) with 18 rows each (K in Null, empty, a; N in Null, 1, 2; twice), no index. Then each statement alone with an image kept after it: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX1 ON X (K); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX2 ON X (K) WITH IGNORE NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX3 ON X (K, N) WITH IGNORE NULL; CREATE INDEX IX4 ON X (K) WITH DISALLOW NULL; CREATE INDEX IX5 ON X (K, N) WITH IGNORE NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX6 ON X (N) WITH IGNORE NULL; CREATE INDEX IX7 ON X (K) WITH PRIMARY; and on X2: ALTER TABLE X2 ADD CONSTRAINT PK_X2 PRIMARY KEY (K); ALTER TABLE X2 ALTER COLUMN K TEXT(20) NOT NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_X2 ON X2 (K, N) WITH DISALLOW NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_X2 ON X2 (K) WITH PRIMARY. Reads every index of X and X2 and walks IX5, IX4 and UX6. Asks which index builds over existing Null and duplicate rows are refused, which options are admitted, what a refused build leaves behind, and how rows with Null components sit in an IGNORE NULL index built over existing data.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
